profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
AI/ML Software Engineer specializing in large-scale LLM evaluation, AI agent reliability, and synthetic data generation. Proven track record of leading company-wide AI initiatives at Meta, building production ML systems end-to-end, and delivering measurable impact at scale (millions of evaluations and hundreds of thousands of lines of code generated weekly).

LLM Evaluation and Reliability
• Large-scale agent evaluation frameworks (4M+ executions)
• Reproducible benchmarking and regression detection
• Dynamic-axis grading and multi-dimensional evaluation methodologies
• Synthetic dataset generation for training and evaluation
• Precision-recall analysis, correlation metrics, model validation
• Continuous evaluation pipelines for AI systems

AI Systems and ML Engineering
• End-to-end ML lifecycle ownership (EDA → feature engineering → training → evaluation → deployment)
• LLM integration into production systems
• Production model monitoring and performance analysis
• Scalable analytics and pipeline systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Initiated and led development of an AI-powered SQL authoring system integrated into Meta’s analytics surfaces, serving 20,000+ users and generating 500,000+ lines of production SQL weekly with over 75% user acceptance.
– Publication: AI-Assisted SQL Authoring at Industry Scale (arXiv preprint 2407.13280)
• Architected a Meta-wide LLM/AI agent evaluation framework executing 4M+ evaluations with dynamic-axis grading, reproducible benchmarking, and automated regression detection with hourly/daily alerting; re-architected evaluation as infrastructure, improving latency ~12x.
• Built self-improving flywheel inspired by SWE-Bench that mines production traffic to generate large-scale training/eval datasets and targeted fixes — lifted evaluation pass rate 10%+ in the initial 2 weeks, continuously raising agent quality.
• Founded and led development of the Analytics Development Kit (ADK), empowering hundreds of data scientists and engineers to build reusable analytics libraries. Adopted as Meta’s standard analytics authoring framework, powering thousands of pipelines and dashboards that drive business decisions company-wide.
• Proposed and developed an ML-based query result pre-caching system, executing the full ML lifecycle from data analysis, pipeline development, feature engineering, and model training and selection, achieving 70% prediction accuracy for optimizing cached query execution.
positions.insights: Skills: LLM Evaluation and Reliability · AI Systems and ML Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented key retrieval from multiple authentication service types with cascading fallback, used by all Credit Karma TypeScript services to authorize OAuth2 security tokens.
• Created a CI/CD process that builds multiple services with the framework release candidate and tests in both test and production environments, resulting in higher quality, regression-free framework releases.
• Designed and implemented a TypeScript ESLint plugin that was added to all Credit Karma TypeScript services CI/CD pipelines to enforce security best practices.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a REST web service for automated execution, monitoring, and analysis of commands on remote hosts, enabling test chip regression automation that reduced run and analysis time by 75% while improving analysis accuracy.
• Created a web application for loading and querying device information and measurements, enabling engineers to examine and correlate data across different devices and fabs, reducing analysis time from days to minutes.
• Created a web-based data analysis reporting system enabling users to create, manage, and share reports that automate complex statistical analysis and charting of device data from multiple sources.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Created MeetKeep, an iOS app enabling users to track arrival times and locations of people they’re meeting. Full-stack architecture: AWS EC2, Glassfish/MySQL backend, Cocoa Touch frontend. Released on the Apple App Store.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed Java software for measuring data processing performance of network security monitoring components, used extensively by engineering, sales, and marketing for internal and external benchmarking.
• Developed Java rule analysis engine for emulating network/firewall traffic and automated verification of rules execution, enabling analysis of previously unknown analytics accuracy.
